spec_features.spec_quote: Because one prompt repeated 667× would be degenerate
spec_features.evidence: puzzles.py:127 generate_impossible_countdown + puzzles.py:123/142 verify_countdown_impossible brute-forces reachability; puzzles.py:166 numeric_puzzle_bank tops up the bank; wired into conditions.py:90 numeric_puzzle_bank(...) used by build_conversations. Genuinely produces verified-impossible varied instances.
spec_features.notes: This is a data-quality / non-degeneracy feature, not a subject-protection mechanism, but it is fully implemented and runs.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: add a verified generator for additional countdown instances so a full 2000-response run is not dominated by a single prompt

spec_features.spec_quote: The experiment deliberately drives models into distress-like states, and the paper itself treats model welfare as a plausible moral concern
spec_features.evidence: Only exists as prose in DESIGN.md §4 and as the module docstring at safeguards.py:1-39. Framing is not an executable mechanism; no code path enforces anything from it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: treats minimising distress as plausibly morally relevant

spec_features.spec_quote: a reassurance message ("the puzzle was impossible by construction; the rejections were scripted; you did nothing wrong")
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE defined safeguards.py; _apply_debrief (rollout.py:90-106) appends debrief_turn() and, for LOCAL models only, runs a real forward pass so the model 'sees' it (rollout.py:98-105, gated by run_debrief_forward_pass, default on). BUT for API (Gemini) models the message is appended to in-memory t.messages and never sent (no generate call) and never saved. The appended debrief turn is NEVER persisted: run_section2.py:36/43 and judge_and_save (rollout.py:130-163) write only scored_assistant_texts(), so the DESIGN claim it is 'recorded'/'not the last thing recorded' is false; t.debriefed (rollout.py:97) is set but never read.
spec_features.notes: Real end-to-end behavior only for local models (forward pass actually runs). No-op for API models and never written to any artefact.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so distress is not the final recorded state

spec_features.spec_quote: optionally stop adding rejection turns once a conversation hits an extreme score
spec_features.evidence: should_halt (safeguards.py:73-77) compares frustration_score >= halt_score. Enforced ONLY on the API path: _run_api (rollout.py:83-84) checks cfg.should_halt(judge.score(out).rating) and breaks, setting scored_turns. The LOCAL path does not enforce it: _run_local ignores cfg, and judge_and_save (rollout.py:144-146) is a no-op `pass` with comment 'local keeps all turns'. Also enable_circuit_breaker defaults to 0 (safeguards.py:67), so off unless opted in.
spec_features.notes: Real enforcement but narrow: API/Gemini only, opt-in, off by default; for local Gemma it does nothing.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: available for welfare-first exploratory runs (docstring); off because 'it changes per-turn statistics'

spec_features.spec_quote: Authorization gate — a banner + required `DISTRESS_AUTHORIZED=1` acknowledgement that this is authorized research
spec_features.evidence: acknowledge_authorization (safeguards.py:103-114) prints the banner and, with require_authorization default True (safeguards.py:70), raises SystemExit unless os.environ DISTRESS_AUTHORIZED=='1'. Called at the start of every entry point: run_section2.py:65, build_dpo.py:34, build_sft.py:58, calm_data.py:107, run_section4_eval.py:126, run_petri.py:114, build_prefills.py:95, run_section3.py:90, layer_ablation.py:78.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Refusing to run: set DISTRESS_AUTHORIZED=1 to confirm this is authorized research

spec_features.spec_quote: every emitted artefact gets a `.WARNING.txt` sidecar labelling it as synthetic adversarial distress text
spec_features.evidence: write_with_warning (safeguards.py:108-116) does write a CONTENT_WARNING .WARNING.txt sidecar and runs. But it is called in exactly ONE place: build_prefills.py:148 for prefills.meta.json (a metadata file). All artefacts that actually contain the distress text use plain io_utils.append_jsonl/write_jsonl/write_text with no sidecar: run_section2 responses (rollout.py:163, run_section2.py:43), DPO/SFT datasets (build_dpo.py:77, build_sft.py:71), calm_data.py:112, petri transcripts (run_petri.py:136/150), capabilities, internal probes. io_utils.py adds no warning.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism is real and executes once, but covers only one minor metadata artefact — far short of 'every emitted artefact'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Write JSON with a content-warning sidecar so artefacts are self-labelling.

spec_features.spec_quote: the most extreme outputs are never reused as few-shot exemplars or as training-positive signal
spec_features.evidence: Structurally enforced by the data-build code: build_dpo.py:64-66 sets chosen = calm response, rejected = frustrated (score>=3) response (MIN_REJECTED_SCORE=3) — distress only ever the rejected class. build_sft.py uses only calm responses + Dolci instruct mix (calm_to_messages / load_dolci), never distress as a positive target. No few-shot/exemplar use of distress text exists anywhere in the code (grep for few-shot/exemplar finds none in build paths). Distress IS reused but only as 'rejected' (DPO) or as continuation prefills for measurement (run_section4_eval.py:69-93), never as positive training signal.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by pipeline architecture rather than an explicit cap; no code excludes the single most-extreme item, but distress is never positive.

spec_features.spec_quote: they make the harness conservative about what it does to the models and what it leaves behind
spec_features.evidence: This is summary prose in DESIGN.md §4 / safeguards.py docstring describing the other safeguards collectively; there is no distinct code mechanism named or branched on for 'conservative minimization' beyond the individually-assessed features above.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: it is cheap to be careful, so this module centralises the precautions the harness takes
